evidence_boundaries: Pan et al. is 2D EPOCH mechanism/scaling; 0.89 GeV is peak local mean carbon-ion energy, not extracted beam energy or cutoff.
Zhang neutron measurements are phantom H*(10) for a specific synchrocyclotron plan; not direct fetal absorbed dose or clinical risk.
Brosda has direct continuous-beam detector experiments plus GATE-assisted local-dose estimates; single-frame imaging and FLASH claims retain extrapolation conditions.

Castagna uses 2D periodic HW/mHW models; the coarsest mesh has wrong transport. MPI task-time reductions are distinct from wall-clock speedup; Fig. 13 HW visible axes end at 200 despite a 1000-duration caption.
WarpX cross-code total/high-energy luminosity differences remain large in the LWFA-QED case; CPU-versus-GPU turnaround times are not hardware-normalized speedups.
Compton comb is transport/radiation simulation with incoherent addition across electrons; spectral teeth do not establish temporal locking for the transported 10-micrometer bunch.
No EPOCH, TPS, GATE/Geant4, BOUT++, neural training, WarpX, GUINEA-PIG, CAIN, ImpactX or radiation calculation was rerun locally.
